status: INVESTIGATIVE / PROSECUTORIAL ANALYSIS — NOT A FINDING OF CRIMINAL OR JUDICIAL MISCONDUCT
scope: Concurso 36/2012 read together with civil, mercantile, concursal, criminal, administrative, regulatory and downstream commercial/financial tracks. The matrix tests whether filings and warnings were met by adequate perimeter, preservation, accounting and implementation controls before LPB assets, the mixed-title hotel, the secured claim and the productive unit acquired additional parallel lives.
core_rule: For every control opportunity show: warning/filing -> verified receipt -> judicial/LAJ/prosecutorial act or response-not-located -> protection granted/refused/narrowed -> parallel life that continued -> later asset/control/value consequence -> criminal element still unproved.
evidence_boundary: A party filing proves that a request or allegation was made and, where a LexNET receipt is controlled, when it entered the court channel; it does not prove every factual proposition in the filing.
An adverse judicial decision is not by itself evidence of prevaricacion, collusion or malicious prosecution.
A response not located in the controlled corpus is a production gap, not proof that no response existed.

Institutional neutralisation or shielding is analysed first as an effect: a warning may be narrowed, rejected, deferred, fragmented or left unreconciled while the challenged private architecture continues. Criminal capture, coordination or intent require separate proof.
The LPB concurso was not a universal title over the hotel. Matkator and other third-party assets/rights require their own title, consent or competent authority.
Downstream investment, regulation, subsidy, licensing or operation does not attribute knowledge or complicity to investors, advisers, public bodies or operators without actor-specific evidence.

failure_modes.test: Was LPB-only insolvency authority kept separate from third-party title, possession, operation and income?
Once warned, was there a timely measure capable of preserving the estate, productive unit, evidence, access and third-party rights?
Were credit, interest, payments, fruits, sale proceeds, adjudication consideration and later recovery reconciled without double or incompatible lives?
Can the filing -> response -> appeal -> finality -> implementation chain be reconstructed without contradictory or missing operative states?
Was a serious substantive complaint decided on its merits, or terminated on standing/procedural grounds while the underlying conduct remained unadjudicated?

Did a complaint/alert lose practical protective force through narrowing, fragmentation, adverse reframing or non-reconciliation while the challenged architecture continued? This is an effect test, not a capture finding.

control_opportunities.title_es: Concurso limitado de LPB frente a hotel de titularidad mixta
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: Opening/liquidation record and repeated ownership/perimeter material establish that the debtor was LPB while the hotel contained non-LPB property and operating rights.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: Primary opening and liquidation decisions controlled in the repository.
control_opportunities.institutional_response: The court exercised insolvency powers over LPB and later suspended LPB's powers in liquidation.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: Did later actors and the court maintain this LPB-only boundary whenever whole-hotel access, operation, works, income or disposal was implicated?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: The hotel continued to exist as one physical/commercial unit despite fragmented title and rights.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: No criminal inference from jurisdiction itself. Any misuse theory requires a specific act beyond lawful LPB authority plus actor-specific knowledge and purpose.

control_opportunities.title_es: Plan de liquidación y aclaración presentada por LPB
control_opportunities.title_en: Liquidation plan and LPB clarification filing
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: LPB requested clarification of the 16 April liquidation-plan approval, including the amount of privileged special credit needed to understand CAM's competitive position.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: LexNET 1201810205126334; filed 24 April 2018 at 09:14; principal document hash 5c49a00269cf5659b68290698ccbb10b3797999d.
control_opportunities.institutional_response: The later 4 June order clarified implementation/competition points but did not grant universal access, possession, security, works or hotel-operation authority.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: Did the court/AC sufficiently separate debt quantification, competitive bidding and title from physical control before implementation accelerated?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: CAM's position operated simultaneously as secured credit, bidder/reference value and later practical control leverage.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: An adverse or incomplete clarification response is not criminal. The issue becomes criminal only if a materially false amount/right was knowingly used to procure a prejudicial decision or disposition.

control_opportunities.title_es: Seguridad/Comunidad y oposición a la liquidación de intereses
control_opportunities.title_en: Security/Community authority and opposition to interest liquidation
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: LPB opposed CAM's 18 May interest-liquidation proposal and argued that privileged interest had to be determined within the liquidation-plan framework.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: LexNET 1201810213090383; filed 4 June 2018 at 19:24; principal hash ff26034fd5db4acefc6673034f52367dda119ff6; annexed 31-May mortgage-debt/finca listing hash f3a8fbb30b02199432b0ddcd6c68a696015d0e22.
control_opportunities.institutional_response: A court Auto dated 4 June was notified through LexNET on 7 June 2018; the controlled repository treats the 4 June judicial position as materially adverse on interest/implementation questions.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: Were credit, interest and bidding mechanics reconciled quickly enough to avoid the creditor position acquiring extra-judicial control functions?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: The same economic claim remained a concursal credit, mortgage/NPL position, bid component and potential route to title/control.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: Different debt figures or adverse interest rulings are not falsity/fraud without the exact false representation, author, knowledge, reliance and prejudicial effect.

control_opportunities.title_es: Ruptura material de control del hotel
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: Contemporaneous 7 June reporting described a forced/material 'toma de posesion' episode, locks/security/exclusion and attached prior complaint/amplification material. The repository separately records the 18 May Community/security authority route.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: Contemporaneous email and attached source family controlled; a specific Concurso 36/2012 LexNET filing/receipt reporting the physical takeover has not yet been promoted as controlled in this matrix.
control_opportunities.institutional_response: No specific judicial order authorising CAM whole-hotel possession, eviction, universal keys or operation is identified in the controlled canonical corpus. The later 26 June order protected only listed mortgaged fincas by suspending realisation.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: Who was notified, when, by what filing; what immediate preservation/access/inventory measure was available; and why did practical control continue if it exceeded the proven authority?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: Physical hotel control/possession became a practical life separate from formal title and separate from the LPB-only insolvency perimeter.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: Possible coercive, disloyal-administration or arbitrary-enforcement theories require actor-specific instruction, scope, knowledge, intent and harm. No common criminal plan is established by the event alone.
control_opportunities.status: CENTRAL EVENT / CONCURSO FILING RECEIPT STILL P0

control_opportunities.title_es: Salida financiada y continuidad de la unidad productiva
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: Stoneweg/VSO, ONA/Clubotel, Ben Oldman and Lagune/Elaia evidence records developed rescue/funding routes of different legal and closing status, with requests for debt quantification and funded conclusion/operation.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: Commercial evidence is controlled; exact court receipt, filing family and full procedural treatment remain incomplete for material funded-exit steps.
control_opportunities.institutional_response: 26 June suspension gave limited protection to specified mortgaged fincas; no single controlled decision is treated as a merits determination that every funded exit was impossible or should be rejected.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: Was a financeable alternative given a traceable judicial/AC decision path before continuity, bookings, operation and value deteriorated or shifted?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: Sun Park existed simultaneously as estate real estate, productive unit, financing target, operating opportunity and later adverse-party project asset.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: Lost rescue is not proven merely by an offer. Causation requires route-specific conditions, authority, financing certainty and the act that prevented closing.
control_opportunities.status: COMMERCIAL COUNTERFACTUAL STRONG / COURT CHAIN PARTIAL

control_opportunities.title_es: 31 fincas, escritura, LAJ y corrección posterior
control_opportunities.title_en: 31 fincas, deed, LAJ direction and later correction
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: The controlled record identifies a 28 November 2018 deed concerning 31 fincas for EUR400,000 before a 12 December LAJ direction to formalise the sale.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: Primary deed and judicial/LAJ family controlled in the specialist corpus.
control_opportunities.institutional_response: The 12 December direction was later set aside by an order dated 24 October 2019; cash/title/restitution/accounting chain remains incomplete.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: How could implementation precede the later direction, what was paid/returned, and how was the estate restored and accounted after the correction?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: The same 31-finca value had a deed life, judicial/LAJ implementation life, later corrective life and unresolved estate-accounting life.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: Temporal anomaly is not falsity or misappropriation without proof of authority, knowledge, payment, use and benefit.

control_opportunities.title_es: Calificación y posible inversión/neutralización del relato
control_opportunities.title_en: Classification proceedings and possible narrative inversion/neutralisation
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: The record contains defence/opposition material, economic expert routes, earlier complaints against AC/CAM, the 12 March 2019 Fiscal opinion, the 2023 hearing and Judgment 163/2023.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: Primary specialist corpus and public classification record controlled; the website states that individual official corroboration of the prosecutor's full-hearing presence remains pending.
control_opportunities.institutional_response: A materially adverse first-instance classification judgment was issued; some adverse allegations were rejected or narrowed, others accepted, and the judgment is appealed.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: Did adverse prosecutorial/classification framing cause complaints against private/AC conduct to lose protective force or become role-reversed, and if so was that ordinary merits disagreement or knowing misuse of materially false/incomplete propositions?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: While LPB/Gil faced an adverse culpability narrative, the challenged asset/control/project architecture continued toward title, financing and operation.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: Malicious prosecution, knowing falsity, retaliation, institutional capture or shielding are not established. Each requires proof of the false proposition, knowledge, improper purpose/coordination where legally required, causal use and actor-specific participation.
control_opportunities.status: ADVERSE OUTCOME REAL / CRIMINAL-MISUSE HYPOTHESIS OPEN

control_opportunities.title_es: RICPE, titularidad mixta y aviso formal
control_opportunities.title_en: RICPE, mixed title and formal notice
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: The controlled chain records Aweswell/LPB material on works, access, estate protection and later RICPE/title issues. RICPE's 20 July certificate described 262 fincas: 54 CAM, 190 LPB components and 18 third-party fincas; CAM filed the certificate on 21 July.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: Primary RICPE certificate and July filing/response family controlled in the repository; exact every-annex receipt/response pairing remains a production task.
control_opportunities.institutional_response: The 24 February 2021 Auto recorded allegations concerning works/access/masa and the AC response; later 2021 judicial treatment proceeded toward bidding/adjudication.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: Once the court had notice of mixed title, works/access and investor-facing project material, what reconciliation was performed before further adjudication/title steps?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: Before final LPB title transfer, Sun Park already had an investor/project life built on a mixed 262-finca perimeter.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: Investor-facing divergence is not fraud without a materially false representation, speaker knowledge, recipient reliance and prejudicial disposition.
control_opportunities.status: PRIMARY NOTICE CHAIN MATERIAL / PAIRING PARTIAL

control_opportunities.title_es: Dos Autos firmados con descripciones incompatibles
control_opportunities.title_en: Two signed orders with incompatible descriptions
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: The contradiction sits inside the judicial record itself rather than depending on a party allegation.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: Two signed Autos dated 15 October 2021 are controlled in the unitary corpus.
control_opportunities.institutional_response: One describes the May bidding event as having occurred with award to the best bidder; another says the event had not even taken place and was not an auction but a flexible appearance for successive bids.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: Was the inconsistency clerical or material; was it corrected and served; which version supported later testimonios, deed, registration or finality?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: The adjudication process had incompatible judicial descriptions while later title implementation continued.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: Contradictory text alone does not establish knowingly unjust adjudication or judicial intent. Materiality, knowledge, correction and causal use must be proved.

control_opportunities.title_es: Testimonios, escritura e inscripción pese a controversias abiertas
control_opportunities.title_en: Certified copies, deed and registration while disputes remained
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: The record preserves documentary challenges and requests around adjudication/title implementation.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: Primary judicial/title family exists; exact service/finality/correction pairing remains incomplete.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: What exact operative decision and finality state authorised each conveyance/cancellation, and how were third-party rights and the 15-Oct contradiction reconciled first?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: LPB's concursal asset life converted into registered-title/project life while the wider hotel and third-party rights remained distinct.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: Registration is legally significant; it does not erase an antecedent defect if proved, and it does not itself prove such a defect.

control_opportunities.title_es: Proyecto, RIC, incentivos y explotación MYND
control_opportunities.title_en: Project, RIC, incentives and MYND operation
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: Earlier title/perimeter/control warnings form the upstream record; later audited accounts, RIC-linked finance and regional-incentive records document downstream project value.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: Public/audited downstream materials controlled in specialist pages.
control_opportunities.institutional_response: Separate investment, fiscal, administrative, licensing and operating channels proceeded; this matrix does not assume those downstream decision-makers had the court-file knowledge.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: Which upstream title/litigation/third-party-rights facts were disclosed to each downstream decision-maker, and did any unresolved judicial defect propagate into later finance/benefit?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: Sun Park became an operating hotel/project life with RIC-linked participating finance, public incentive and commercial operation.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: Downstream value or public support does not prove laundering, fraud, complicity or institutional shielding. Knowledge and reliance must be traced recipient by recipient.
control_opportunities.status: DOWNSTREAM LIFE DOCUMENTED / KNOWLEDGE BRIDGES OPEN

control_opportunities.title_es: Separación del AC, honorarios y acceso al fondo
control_opportunities.title_en: IA removal, fees and access to merits
control_opportunities.party_filing_or_warning: Specialist public corpus contains removal and fee challenges with seven substantive removal grounds and material fee objections.
control_opportunities.verified_receipt: 50-document public-safe specialist corpus: 25 court/LAJ acts and 25 party filings on the removal/fees routes.
control_opportunities.institutional_response: Located first-instance routes were dismissed on standing/legitimacy; the identified first-instance decisions did not determine the seven removal grounds or material legality/quantum of the fees on the merits. Appeals remain subject to signed outcome/finality control.
control_opportunities.failure_or_control_question: Can serious estate-protection allegations receive a merits determination through any competent route, or do procedural gates leave the underlying conduct repeatedly unadjudicated?
control_opportunities.parallel_life_continuing: The challenged AC conduct/fee issues remain capable of affecting final estate accounting even after title/project transition.
control_opportunities.criminal_test: Procedural dismissal is not judicial shielding. A criminal theory requires proof that a competent actor knowingly used an improper procedural device or false premise for an unlawful protective purpose.

neutralisation_shield_hypothesis.status: EFFECT TEST ONLY — CRIMINAL CAPTURE NOT ESTABLISHED
neutralisation_shield_hypothesis.statement: The investigative hypothesis to test is whether repeated narrowing, adverse reframing, procedural termination, non-reconciliation or delayed protection had the practical effect of neutralising complaints and preserving the adverse-party architecture long enough for credit/control/project positions to become harder to reverse. The corpus does not presently establish an agreement by judges, prosecutors or public bodies to shield private parties.
must_prove_for_criminal_upgrade: improper purpose or legally required intent

cross_border_eu_lane.note: This audit did not identify a controlled repository source sufficient to make an actor-specific criminal attribution to any France-, Brussels- or EU-based institution. Any such lane must remain separate until the exact filing, authority, recipient, receipt, response and alleged protective effect are identified.
